pages.text: I can release selected structural materials from the world’s support.

$(bold)Mana:$() 1 bucket$(br)$(bold)Mode:$() Instant$(br2)Aim at an eligible block within eight blocks. Every block in the lapidary:gravity_affected tag inside a four-block sphere becomes a Falling Block entity. Logs and leaves are included; block entities and unsafe special blocks are excluded. The falling entities do not create item drops.
